# OKCompressor / OKC

OKC builds small reversible machines for information: compression experiments, byte rotors, corpus tools and reproducible research artifacts.

## Important pages

- /index.html — public shelf and current drops
- /products/ock-rotor.html — OCK Rotor Free / source-commercial boundary
- /licensing.html — Luna Non-Commons v1.1 and commercial boundary
- /contact.html — inquiry/contact routes
- /projects/tools.html — public tools

## Current artifacts

- OCK Rotor Free v0.4.0 — public experimental Linux x86_64 prerelease for arbitrary-file reversible byte-rotor experiments.
  - Repository: https://github.com/OKCompressor/ock-rotor
  - Release: https://github.com/OKCompressor/ock-rotor/releases/tag/v0.4.0
  - Artifact ledger: https://github.com/OKCompressor/core/tree/main/drops/ock-rotor/v0.4.0
- OKPass — PDF/TXT vocabulary extraction and passphrase/key-material generation.

## Licensing

- Luna Non-Commons License v1.1: https://github.com/OKCompressor/core/blob/main/docs/LICENSE.md
- Human experimentation and independent use follow each artifact's published terms.
- Commercial organizational use, source access, integration and technical transfer are separate agreement lanes.

## Boundaries

- Experimental software.
- OCK Rotor is not audited encryption.
- No behavioral tracking or registration is required by OKC for public artifacts.
